title: Command palette (ctrl+p)
brief: Command palette of goop, opened with ctrl+p and modeled on opencode's DialogSelect. A centered ~720px dialog on --background-panel (no border, no radius) sits over the dimmed, inert 04 session; the session keeps its status line, now in the commands focus mode (command palette open · ? help), and the composer edge turns --border. Header, inset 4 cells: bold Commands on the left, muted esc on the right. Below it the search input: placeholder Search, auto-focused, lavender cursor. With nothing typed, the list is grouped under bold --accent category headers indented 3 cells: Suggested, Offers, Search, Session, Agents & models, System. Each row has a title, an optional muted inline description, and its keybind or slash command right-aligned and muted. The selected row is filled --primary with bold --background text; a --primary ● in the gutter marks an item that is on. Main frame: the query 'of' flattens the list to matches, with matched letters bold and the category on the right instead of the keybind. Bottom hint row: bold action, muted key (select ↵ · move ↑↓ · close esc), ctrl+p on the right. Below the screen: the unfiltered grouped list and the No results found state.

artboards.title: Dialog
artboards.tradeoff: One keystroke reaches every action and the categories teach the slash commands, but the dialog hides the conversation while open, the unfiltered list scrolls at 900px, and the filled orange selection and bold-action hint row are palette-only exceptions to the system rules
